scope: The Lyric Theatre at 27–29 Shaftesbury Avenue, London, as photographed in April 2007, including its stage and auditorium envelope and the retained William Hunter house front on Great Windmill Street.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Five-bay brick and stone Shaftesbury Avenue front with three gabled pavilions, arcade and slate roof. The retained red brick house front on Great Windmill Street has five sash bays and four storeys.
The operator confirms the Shaftesbury Avenue venue address and theatre history.

sectionBasis: Slate auditorium and stage volumes, brick and pale stone Shaftesbury Avenue front with three gabled pavilions, and the four-storey retained Hunter house at the stage end.
